comment: Accepted dependency-advisory exceptions. Each id here must match package.json pnpm.auditConfig.ignoreGhsas exactly, and make cve-scan fails once `expires` has passed: renew with a new dated entry (new decision date, new expiry) or delete the exception and its ignoreGhsas id.
